text: Alpharius has told me that if I find strange or 'imperfect' objects, that I can trade them to him for rewards.
Gear Pilgrimage
A temple priest tasked me with going to the gear shrines in the Hub and Industrial Districts, in a pilgrimage. Once I have visited each of these shrines, I am to return.
I have completed the pilgrimage, and returned to the priest. I was rewarded with his blessing.
Clocktower Crazy

I found a note in a house in the slums, detailing a fabricant's descent into madness. He believes that he can shut down the clocktower to divert its power. This can only end badly, and as such, I should stop him.
I convinced the clocktower manager to allow me access to the upper levels.
I found the crazed fabricant, trapped in several mechanisms. Despite this, he still believes that the clocktower should be deactivated. If I free him, I may be attacked.
I freed the fabricant, who, predictably, attacked me. I have killed him, and the clocktower is safe from whatever he wanted to do with it.
I convinced the fabricant that his schemes were pointless, and freed him. He will no longer attempt any sort of... whatever, and the clocktower is safe from whatever he wanted to do with it.
I, Centurion
The owner of the Residential District's emporium had one of his steam centurions walk out of his shop one night, and he has been looking for it ever since. He has asked me to help in the search.
One of the district guides mentioned a centurion going towards the slums, but thought nothing of it.
I have found the steam centurion in the slums. Somehow, it believes it is a normal fabricant, and will not go back to the Emporium. I could let it live, or reprogram it somehow.
The ghost of a dwemer mechanic gave me a tool which should reset the centurion.
I reprogrammed the centurion, which headed back to Kummuuuu.
Kummuuuu thanked me for the return of his centurion, and rewarded me with a key for Fyr Manor.
I lied and told Kummuuuu that his centurion was destroyed and unrecoverable. He thanked me, but regretted the loss of one of his prized machines.
Reconstruction
A hanged fabricant, whose body was stolen from him, has asked me to check merchant shops for those same body parts, and return to him.
I found the rest of the hanged man's body, and helped rebuild him. He was grateful, and though poor, rewarded me nonetheless.
The Great Plant Rescue
Golamus has asked me to break into a storage room in the Arboretum and recover a plant that is to be destroyed.
I recovered the plant and returned to Golamus. Subsequently, I was rewarded.
Fight Club
The Abstemious have heard rumors of an underground animal fighting ring. As activists in the city, they wish for me to investigate these rumors, and if they are true, shut the ring down.
I convinced a farmer in the Arboretum to escort me after 8 PM to where this ring is taking place.
I have arrived at the fight ring, which does indeed exist. I must find a way to shut it down for good.
I freed the fabricant livestock that had been used to fight. They are rampaging through the club. Hopefully this should be the end of things.
I met, and convinced the head of the fight club to give up his endeavors. Things should stop now.
I killed the head of the fight club. With no one to organize things, it will hopefully fall.
The Abstemious learned of my success, and thanked and rewarded me.
Lost My Mind
I have been asked to find part of a mind for a damaged overclocker, whose Pneuma was shattered. He says he does not remember where it is, but remembers trees and beds.
I returned the mind part to the overclocker. Unfortunately, he learned that he was previously an abstemious, and the realization has only served to depress him.
Scaling New Heights
An Overclocker has asked me to place five measuring contraptions in various containers around the city. These special containers can be found at high points in each district, excluding the slums.
I have placed all of the contraptions in their places. The Overclocker has offered me a token for a free augmentation as a reward.
Kill the Overclocker and Abstemious Leaders
A shady fabricant has asked me to kill both the Overclocker and Abstemious leaders. I will be well rewarded.
I have killed both leaders. I was rewarded with a set of armor of my choice, as well as a good deal of money.
I killed the shady fabricant instead.
Getting Ahead
I met a headless fabricant in the Temple district, who seems to want a piece of paper.
Using the paper, the fabricant explained how it had its head stolen by bonespiders, down in the catacombs. He has asked for me to retrieve it.
I returned the headless man's head. He was grateful, and rewarded me.
The New Guard
A fabricant has asked me to find someone to take the place of the now dead guard of the containment center. He suggested I ask around the slums for any old warriors who might be interested.

I have met a man named Urusai, who fits the criteria for guarding the containment center. However, he believes that such work is beneath him, and will only agree to the position if I am able to beat him in a hand-to-hand duel.
I have beaten Urusai, who, true to his word, has wandered off to become the containment tower's new guard.
Dead Hour

The Archcanon has told me that every few nights, the dead of the catacombs beneath the district rise up and attack the residents. He knows not why, but has asked me to speak to the four factions in the Temple district, to see if I could find any clues.
The Watch claimed to know nothing.
The Wonder claimed to know nothing.
The Build claimed to know nothing.
The Tear Down claimed to know nothing.

I witnessed a group of undead attacking a fabricant couple, who belonged to the Build. I managed to drive off the undead, but one of the victims was not so lucky. His partner claimed that the undead were trying to remove his arm, which was recently bought from an augmentation dealer who sells his wares at the entrance of the district.

The Overclockers, who oversee most augmentations, claim that no religious groups have come in to augment themselves recently, and if any of them did, they most likely would have bought their new parts from a black market merchant. I should find a traveling merchant.
Alpharius, the clockseller, told me that while he does not deal in arms, he knows of a man who does. He can be found selling wares in the Temple District for an hour each day, from 5PM to 6PM.
The arms merchant claims that he buys his wares from robed figures in the northern corner of the district at midnight each night.

The robed figures turned out to be part of a coven of fabricant liches! They are stealing the parts from bodies in the catacombs and selling them to people. I must enter the catacombs and destroy these liches once and for all. But, I know nothing about these "rewounds". I should make sure to research them before I enter.
All the liches are dead, and the Temple district is once again safe.
A Watery Affair

Subori has asked me to follow her husband and see where he goes at night. She suspects he is seeing another woman, and wants her killed. She says he leaves bottles out, and they might form a trail that indicates the exact location of where he's been running off to.
I followed the trail Subori's husband at night, only to find that he and several friends are part of a gentlemen's club that participates in drinking water, which is a rare delicacy for fabricants.
Though reluctant, Subori believed me about her husband's rather innocent activities. I was rewarded for my time.
The Heist

A fabricant named Numinar has discovered that a powerful dwemer weapon, a cutting sphere, lies within the vaults of the Watchman Headquarters. Unfortunately, only Watchmen themselves are allowed to enter. He has devised a plan, which  involves me leading a watchmen to a platform in the alley behind his workshop. He will tell me more once I have done this.

I lead the Watchmen onto the platform. Both of us were shocked, but the Watchman was disabled and brought inside. Numinar is going to repurpose the Watchman into a suit of armor, which I will then wear to infiltrate the Watchmen's HQ.
I have donned the Watchman disguise. I cannot talk to anyone, and should move as quickly as possible to the Headquarters.
I have managed to enter the Watchmen Headquarters. I should be looking for the vaults, and the cutting sphere.
I have found the cutting sphere, now to return to Numinar.
I gave Numinar the cutting sphere, and was rewarded in turn.
A Tale of Two Farmers: The Naturalist

In the Arboretum I met one of two rival farmers, who believes that naturally grown fabricant livestock are the best. His rival, a man who believes that machine-based fabricant livestock are better, infuriates him. He has asked me to break into his rival's house, and plant false evidence convicting him of poisoning his fabricants.
I have planted the evidence.
I returned to the farmer, who thanked and rewarded me, despite his rival not being arrested yet.
A Tale of Two Farmers: The Mechanist

In the Arboretum I meant one of two rival farmers, who believes that machine-based fabricant livestock are the best. His rival, a man who believes that  naturally grown fabricant livestock are better, infuriates him. He has asked me to break into his rival's house, and plant false evidence convicting him of poisoning his fabricants.
I have planted the evidence.
I returned to the farmer, who thanked and rewarded me, despite his rival not being arrested yet.
Both farmers have been arrested for evidence that suggests their fabricants were poisoned.
A Show To Remember
A hopeless love-struck fabricant has asked me to place some fireworks in several chimneys throughout the slums. He hopes that by setting them off, he'll attract the eye of a girl he fancies.

I set up the fireworks, which the man detonated. Unforunately, they went off too early, and the entire district caught fire.
I was rewarded anyways.
Murders in the Residential District
Aroban has told me that someone is killing his dancers, and wishes for me to talk to them and, hopefully, find a lead.
I spoke to one of the dancers, a girl named Miri. She is by far the most paranoid of everyone here, and believes she is next. She has asked me to meet her outside the club at 9 PM to escort her home.
As she expected, we were attacked by undead. I fended them off, and should investigate their origins.
The city's lich, a man named Favthali, told me that he had sold the undead to a man named Irim in the eastern Residential District.
Climbing through a secret passage in "Irim's" house, I found myself facing Miri. Apparently she is stripping the dancers of their body parts to become wealthy.
After a battle, Miri is dead.
Aroban was surprised that Miri was behind it, but ultimately wasn't that surprised. He rewarded me.
The Chronographers
I have been asked to give the Archcanon a starmap, in Sotha Sil's lab.
I have given the Archcanon the starmap. They have departed the city to live among the stars.
Slagtown Redemption

Having murdered the fabricants in the slums in self-defense, most of the people living there now see me as a monster. There must be SOME way to earn their forgiveness. Perhaps the archcanon of Sotha Sil would know more.

The archcanon told me that the Slums have beggar's shrines located at each corner of the district. In truth, they are pieces of machinery that I can use to effectively "reset" the memories and feelings of the slum denizens. I'd have to activate each shrine, but in doing so, I could find a modicum of forgiveness.
Having used all four beggar's shrines in the Slums, I have managed to force the slum denizens to forgive me. I should be able to freely use their services now.
Advertising

A fabricant named Pevlar has recently invented a series of fast-transit magical doors, but nobody seems to be aware of their existence. He has asked me to hand out at least four flyers to people who, in turn, might distribute them to others. I should find community leaders and tavern keepers, as they would be most likely to do this.
I handed out all four flyers, and returned to Pevlar. He has rewarded me with a Fyr Manor key.
Finding Quartz
The quartz smith in the Arboretum has given me a pickaxe. If I use it to mine bits of quartz (which can be found around the city) he will trade me such quartz for actual quartz armor.
When in Sotha Sil, do as the Sotha Silians do

I have, amazingly, met a normal dunmer in Sotha Sil. Confused and not completely sure of where he is, he has been trying to blend in, and fears for his life. He won't calm down, but perhaps if he trusted me, he would listen.
I have befriended the normal man, and calmed him down. He has begged me to find him a way home, but if I cannot, perhaps I can find another solution.
I have convinced the man to transfer his mind into a fabricant body, though I will need to find someone willing to do this process.
The head of augmentation agreed to turn my normal friend into a fabricant.
I found a group of teleportation mages, who have agreed to try and send my normal friend back to Tamriel.
I returned to the normal man with the good news. He was thankful, and rewarded me.

I have eased the troubles of all the districts in the city, and as such, the Archcanon has opened a doorway into the workshop of Sotha Sil. This doorway is located in the Clocktower, in the Hub District.

Deep within the Clockwork City, I encountered a strange machine that seems to spend its day sorting magical memories. It won't let me leave its chamber until I've helped it place six memories into their proper receptacles, but I can only view smalls bits and pieces of the memories in question.
I've sorted the Assembly General's memories, and as such it has allowed me to leave.
I have been transported to Sotha Sil's Clockwork City.
I have found the corpse of Sotha Sil. The god's body has been ravaged by powerful forces.

Almalexia has appeared in the Clockwork City, and revealed all. Using the dimension traveling powers of the Mazed Band, Almalexia traveled to the Clockwork City to slay Sotha Sil and to portal the Fabricants to Mournhold. She believes the time of the Tribunal is ended, and she alone may usher Morrowind into a new era as the one savior of her people. I fear it is Almalexia who has gone mad, and not Sotha Sil.
